auth.title: SolarEdge V2 Site Access
auth.description: Register a Site Access application on developer.solaredge.com with SITE_DATA scope. Enter credentials only here, never in a chat. The redirect URI must exactly match your app registration.

authorize.title: Authorize your SolarEdge site
authorize.description: [Open SolarEdge consent]({authorization_url}) in another tab. Select the configured site and approve. Copy the complete final URL from the address bar into this form, even if the redirect page cannot load. This is a manual callback flow; do not share the URL. If authorization fails, open the consent link again.
